title: 2026 GHG conversion-factor QA, provenance and governance controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Conversion factors 2026: statement of voluntary compliance with the Code of Practice for Statistics

facts.source_fact: The 2026 government conversion factors were published on 11 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Version-pin calculations to the stated factor year and publication.

facts.source_fact: The factors can calculate emissions from activity data such as volume of fuel used.
facts.expected_handling: Require compatible activity units before applying fuel factors.

facts.source_fact: The factors can calculate emissions from purchased electricity in kWh.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply electricity factors to unconverted non-kWh activity without explicit unit conversion.

facts.source_fact: The factors can calculate emissions from distance travelled.
facts.expected_handling: Require a transport activity basis compatible with the selected factor.

facts.source_fact: The publication supports reporting Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 emissions separately.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge scope outputs without preserving scope labels.

facts.source_fact: The factors are suitable for UK-based organisations of all sizes.
facts.expected_handling: Do not restrict factor eligibility by organisation size.

facts.source_fact: International organisations may use the factors for their UK operations.
facts.expected_handling: Apply UK-operation boundary rather than organisation domicile alone.

facts.source_fact: The factors are relevant to Environmental Reporting Guidelines including SECR.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve SECR/reporting context when using the factors for corporate reporting.

facts.source_fact: The factors may be used for other purposes, but the publication says users do so at their own risk.
facts.expected_handling: Flag non-standard uses instead of presenting them as endorsed use cases.

facts.source_fact: DESNZ distinguishes these activity-based factors from Defra spend-based emissions multipliers.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute spend-based multipliers for activity-based factors without method disclosure.

facts.source_fact: Spend-based methods can provide an initial full-supply-chain assessment where activity data are insufficient.
facts.expected_handling: Label spend-derived results as method-dependent estimates.

facts.source_fact: Users should report the methods used for emissions accounting.
facts.expected_handling: Require method provenance with calculated results.

facts.source_fact: The factors are updated annually with methodology and major-changes reports.
facts.expected_handling: Carry factor-year provenance and review annual changes before year-on-year comparison.

facts.source_fact: New users are instructed to read general guidance and worksheet-specific guidance/FAQs.
facts.expected_handling: Do not automate a factor without capturing worksheet-specific constraints.

facts.source_fact: Regular users are instructed to review the What's new worksheet for significant changes affecting comparability.
facts.expected_handling: Add a comparability review gate when factor year changes.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary Code statement is organised around Trustworthiness, Quality and Value.
facts.expected_handling: Record governance assurance separately from numerical factor values.

facts.source_fact: DESNZ states the conversion factors are not statistics themselves but a tool for calculating emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label the factor table itself as an emissions-statistics observation.

facts.source_fact: The conversion factors are based primarily on the National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory.
facts.expected_handling: Record NAEI provenance for factor lineage.

facts.source_fact: The NAEI is compiled according to the IPCC 2006 Guidelines.
facts.expected_handling: Retain the stated methodological standard in provenance metadata.

facts.source_fact: The inventory and factor process includes government QA, steering/peer review and external expert scrutiny including UNFCCC review.
facts.expected_handling: Require QA/provenance evidence before treating a factor update as high-confidence.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable accounting/scheme boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference year, publication/update date and provisional/final status where applicable.
Carry source URL, publisher and method/provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert this document/method rule into a parcel-level measured emission without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
